topic: Every git workflow in this repository that can fail, revert, block or mislead an automated run: fan-out lineages, detached CLI children, launch-wrapper sessions and hooks with nobody at a prompt.

focus: Hooks with nobody at the prompt
noveltyJustification: First pass; all eight findings new to this lineage.
keyQuestions: Q1: hook non-interactive failure modes, bypass discoverability, linked-worktree hook resolution
answeredQuestions: Q1: reproduced worktree hook shadowing, spec-remint and next-index blocks, commit-msg matrix, dispatch-guard denial, installer global-hooksPath re-point

noveltyJustification: Second angle; 7 newly reproduced failure modes plus 2 code-confirmed behavior notes.
keyQuestions: Q2: what state of live branch/primary checkout/worktree makes autosync, follower, wrapper or reaper refuse, rebase, reset or delete
answeredQuestions: Q2: reproduced diverged rebase SHA rewrite, conflict abort, dirty/stale-rebase refusals, autostash guard timing gap, reaper base mis-resolution, reaper removal under a detached child

noveltyJustification: Third angle; reproduced the add-pathspec false fire and the reset-hard false silence; mapped all cwd-sensitive rules.
keyQuestions: Q3: reproduce add-pathspec-matches-nothing from a linked worktree; find the computing line; list other rules that misfire under worktree/detached HEAD
answeredQuestions: Q3: misfire is a context-cwd defect; -C and inner cd both false-fire; wrong cwd can silence reset-hard; detached HEAD inert for current rules

noveltyJustification: Fourth angle; reproduced misattribution and both watchdog reset legs against the shipped runtime modules; exposed ambient-config dependence.
keyQuestions: Q4: reproduce out-of-lineage write misattribution; explain watchdog resets and the print-mode gap; name the seam
answeredQuestions: Q4: tracked out-of-lineage writes are attributed and reverted (patch saved); untracked preserved; watchdog resets on stdout+artifact progress only; seam = deep-loop runtime

noveltyJustification: Fifth angle; allocator lock hole reproduced, detachment survivorship established, all findings sorted and ranked into two fix buckets with per-fix tests.
keyQuestions: Q5: detached-process death, moving branch, killed-allocator locks, stale worktree registrations, global config, GIT_* leaks; sort and rank the plan
answeredQuestions: Q5: allocator no-pid lock wedges 30s; nohup survives the tool shell; stale registrations handled; moving branch by design; host-global config participates; ranked plan A1-A10/B1-B4 with tests

convergenceReport: 5/5 forced depth; Q1-Q5 answered; newInfoRatio trend 1.0, 0.9, 0.8, 0.75, 0.7
